driver.description: Sets the builder driver to be used

driver-opts.description: List of additional driver-specific options. (eg. image=moby/buildkit:master)

install.description: Sets up docker build command as an alias to docker buildx build

endpoint.description: Optional address for docker socket or context from `docker context ls`

platforms.description: Fixed platforms for current node. If not empty, values take priority over the detected ones

append.description: Append additional nodes to the builder

cleanup.description: Cleanup temp files and remove builder at the end of a job
